rows.why: metal box outside in the shade: follows air temperature, enclosure adds heat
room under a corrugated metal roof: some damping, roof heat gain
thick mud-brick or block room: daily swing damped, same mean
on the floor of the coolest interior room, ground-coupled

sources: Lumped two-node thermal model. Pack: the selected kit's 25.6 V, 75 Ah LFP module (1.92 kWh), ~18 kg, cp ~1100 J/(kg K), ~15 mOhm (8 prismatic cells + busbars and BMS; first placement study used the 51.2 V, 100 Ah, ~45 kg, ~25 mOhm placeholder pack). Placement time constants and offsets are scenario assumptions (engineering judgement), to be measured with a temperature logger in pilot homes.
